p:cNvPr.descr: 500 CIVIL SERVANTS HAVE BENEFITED FROM ONLINE TRAINING COURSES DURING MAY 2016 – BIPA

a:r.a:t: CIPD Level-3, TESOL & TEFL Certified Business Trainer
Masters in Mechanical Engineering from MS University, Gujarat, India
Gold medalist in Bachelor of Technology in Mechanical Engineering from Gujarat University, India.

Supriya has experience as a Strategy Consultant, Corporate Trainer, and academic tutor. In the past 7 years, she has been actively engaged in advisory engagement encompassing feasibility studies, design and development of policies, process re-engineering, strategy management, and project management areas. She has also been a corporate trainer for the last 5 years having advised family businesses and private sector entities.

In the recent past, she has worked with prestigious clients including Bahrain Qualifications Agency, Bahrain Development Bank, Bahrain Islamic Bank, Bahrain Institute of Public Policy, Shell Fisheries, Adaptive Techsoft LLC, Shifa AL Jazira Medical Center, JCDC, Bahrain airport, Bahrain educational review committee, Gulf Air for the development of policies, procedures as well as process re-engineering.
She has delivered multiple corporate trainings in areas of HR management, Strategy Governance and Management, as well as Corporate Governance through enforcement of policies and procedures.

She has mapped as-is state processes across different departments within BDB, aligning them with the bank’s policy documentation and regulatory guidance from the Central Bank of Bahrain. This work was essential for BDB's digital transformation and new core banking system adoption, have led an ERP implementation project for an airport, optimizing operations and integrating systems, have assisted in the digital transformation project for the Educational Review Committee. She created job descriptions (JDs) and a KPI strategy for an airline company. She was responsible for documenting the entire policy process for a development company in Saudi Arabia. Have conducted feasibility studies in diverse sectors including paint and industrial coating manufacturing, healthcare, food and beverage (F&B), label manufacturing, e-commerce, payment gateways, and general services.
Supriya has delivered numerous board and management-level presentations and provided training for key stakeholders during strategy and digital transformation projects.
She is skilled in using Asana, Trello, ERP systems, Power BI, and Microsoft Visio for project management and visual representation.

Supriya served as a lecturer at the University of Bahrain in the Engineering department and conducted corporate training in the healthcare sector focusing on accreditation requirements and compliance processes. She also has four years of experience in academic training in engineering colleges in India.
